messages:
maria: Quick sync 1: consolidating SDK snippet updates for streaming + pagination across py/ts/go. Also renaming `retries` -> `max_attempts`. I opened tracker + lang PRs. Need review/merge order.
jeff: links?
maria: tracker: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 py: /pull/810 ts: /pull/811 go: /pull/809
kai: Go PR failing lint; snippet needs to use stream.Recv() -> (chunk, done, err). Proposed short example: ```go // stream read client := inference.NewClient(apiKey) ctx := context.Background() s, _ := client.Stream(ctx, req) for { chunk, done, err := s.Recv() if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) } fmt.Print(chunk.Text) if done { break } } ``` (note: done true means stream finished)
alisa: TS should use async iterator + show AbortController for cancel/resume. ```ts const ac = new AbortController() const stream = client.stream(req, { signal: ac.signal, max_attempts: 2 }) for await (const ch of stream) { if (shouldStop()) { ac.abort(); break } console.log(ch.text) } ```
jeff: Python example must show max_attempts and how to resume with cursor: ```py client = RedwoodClient(api_key) with client.stream(req, max_attempts=3) as s: for chunk in s: print(chunk.text, end="") # persist chunk.cursor to resume later ```
devex: Add migration note + redirect so searches for `retries` find `max_attempts`. Update SDK changelog.
ci-bot: CI: tracker PR failed md-lint (codeblock language missing) and long lines.
maria: Kai please add language tags and wrap lines ~100 chars; also add tiny note about done bool.
kai: Fixed and pushed. PTAL.
jeff: Added migration blurb and backward-compat wrapper example in Python PR. CI green for py.
alisa: TS PR updated with pagination note: persist cursor to resume. CI green for ts.
ci-bot: Go PR lint fixed; tests passed.
maria: Merge order: python, typescript, go, then tracker. I'll merge after 10m no objections.
(10m)
ci-bot: Merged 810, 811, 809, 812. Docsite build OK.
maria: Done, release notes updated. Thanks all!
